_doc: One table of limits per form (round 2 X2, C12). desc_check.py, post_check.py and ig_check.py read it: a limit changes in one place. hashtags: warn above 'warn', fail above 'fail'. Sources: SYNTH2-yt-description D6/D9 (long 15/16 use 0 in the first lines), SYNTH2-shorts (#shorts 0/10 creators), SYNTH2-linkedin R1 (6/6 median 0), SYNTH2-instagram R1 (IG doc: 3-5). Long: global 8/9 creators use 0, the 3 Polish ones 3-7 (SYNTH2-long, resynth 2026-11-07): warn above 3, fail above 7 (the most seen). short_desc (round 2 S2/S3, 32 shorts): lines and words counted BEFORE the long's link and the footer; title_copy_max = share of the title's words the description may repeat. instagram (SYNTH2-instagram): 5 tags = platform limit (R1), 2200 caption (R2, secondary), ~125 before 'więcej' (R2, secondary), 5-10 slides ok and 20 max (R6), alt_max 1000 = API value, not verified (R12).
